decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used for the external surfaces of the extension shall match those used on the existing property.
Condition : 3 - No additional door or window openings shall be provided in the external walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The ground floor window formed in the north west elevation of the extension shall be obscurely glazed, and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 5 - The roof of the ground floor part of the extension shall not be altered or adapted for use as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of part 2 storey part single storey rear extension to house
